name: Demucs v4 (htdemucs_ft) - best quality
summary: Fine-tuned Hybrid Transformer Demucs: a bag of four models, one per stem. Four stems.
quality: Fine-tuned version of htdemucs; slightly better than htdemucs per the upstream README.
speed: Four model passes per chunk: about four times slower than htdemucs.
